simple.meaning: תְּרַע (tᵉraʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a door ; by implication, a palace.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תְּרַע (H8651) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 2:49, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּרַע (H8651) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תְּרַע (H8651) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תְּרַע (tᵉraʻ) / H8651 is traced through Daniel 2:49, Daniel 3:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
